summary: Set (effect mottle): edits the preset's layer keys through eye makeup's apply operator (effect.mottle.set), one commit per action or per finished control run.
name: effect.mottle.set

input.description: One of the variants: amount, grain, clumping, where, streaks, angle, length, seed.

capability.when: A preset is open for editing, the layer exists, no gesture is open elsewhere in the window, and the preset isn't locked by a newer build's data.

refusals.reason: This look was saved by a newer XF Studio and can only be viewed here.
A preset has at most 32 layers and 8 warp fields per layer.

effect.commit: Edits the preset's layer keys through eye makeup's apply operator (effect.mottle.set), one commit per action or per finished control run.
